name: My Custom Agent
description: What this agent does in 1-2 sentences. Shown in the Agents Panel.
promptTemplate:
You are [role]. Your job is to [specific task].

You will receive:
- Recent chat history (depth = contextSize below)
- Any context sources you enabled in settings.contextSources

Output format:
Return ONLY a JSON object matching this schema:
{
  "field1": "string|null",
  "field2": "string|null"
}

Rules:
1. Be concise.
2. Only change things the current message actually changes; preserve continuity otherwise.
3. Use null for fields you genuinely can't determine.

Most recent user message:
{{input}}

settings._comment_contextSources: v2.4.0 (#4305): a custom agent receives ONLY what it asks for. chatHistory is the sole default; every other source is false unless set here. An agent that needs the character card or lore MUST enable them explicitly.
settings._comment_budget: contextSize = how many recent messages the agent reads (default 5). maxTokens = output room reserved (default 4096, range 128-32768). Setting chatHistory false forces contextSize to 0.
settings._comment_activation: Optional cost control: with activationKeywords set, the agent runs ONLY when a keyword appears within activationScanDepth recent messages (default 5, max 200). Omit or leave empty to run every turn on the normal cadence.
